notes: GEO sample metadata explicitly provides a time-to-event-like variable as 'survival post g207 (days)' for each patient/sample.
The paper explicitly refers to this endpoint as overall survival ('OS') and describes it as 'patient survival (measured in days posttreatment)' / 'survival duration post-G207'.
No explicit event/status field is present in the GSM metadata because all 6 patients in the cohort died (100% event occurrence, 0% censoring).
Because there is no censoring, the authors analyzed this strictly as a continuous variable using a Spearman rank-order correlation rather than traditional survival models.
The available time variable appears to represent survival duration after G207 treatment rather than from initial diagnosis.
